A Japanese business seeking engineering capability in India

Choose the operating approach before committing to a delivery model.

The situation

A Japanese company needs additional engineering and digital capability. It is considering project-based support, a dedicated provider team or its own centre in India.

How SetuHashi could help

Compare the options against the company’s needs and management capacity, assess providers, prepare a pilot and coordinate the selected set-up with appropriate specialists.

What the assignment could produce

An operating-route recommendation, provider assessment, pilot framework and ramp-up plan.

The intended value

An investment decision based on the capability required, the economics and what the organization can effectively manage.

Related services

  • Establish cross-border operations
  • Develop workable agreements
  • Prepare teams to work together
  • Bring organizations together to deliver
